name: Drosophila - Adult Fruit Fly - CT Scan
author: etainproject
description:
*Drosophila* anatomy from a CT-Scan.

**Name:** Drosophila melanogaster- Fruit Fly - Adult
**Order:** Diptera
**Family:** Drosophilidae
**Species:** Drosophila melanogaster
**Stage:** adult - female
**Origin:** Reared in the lab of Herman Wijnen at University of Southampton, UK, in 2022
**Classification:** 2022 by Herman Wijnen of University of Southampton, UK, and [Duncan Bell](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Geoffrey-Bell-2)
of Suffolk University
**Preservation:**  Fixed in Bouin’s solution, then stained for 2d in Lugol’s solution prior to scanning in ultrapure water.
**Scanning:**  Done by dr. Orestis Katsamenis using a custom Nikon XTH225ST μCT system. 
**Post-Processing:** Model processed by [Felipe Ribas](https://orcid.org/0009-0003-0433-4542) using Blender.
**Publication Date:** 22/07/2024
